Preserved under `rdp_media/qb_2124478684/`.

## Summary

He spent the weekend digging through and evaluating the trading systems people share online. Verdict, in his own bullets:

- **99% are shit, and their PnL is even worse.**
- **Only ~0.01% look research-based** — and even those "were probably rationalized after the fact": the research narrative is fitted to the system, not the other way around.
- **The rest come from data mining and parameter optimization** — and the parameter-optimized ones rely on technical indicators and "show clear signs of overfitting."
- **A couple of decent, stable systems exist** — the photo's smooth equity curve is his exhibit for "this one" — but they now need "a second round of tests to make sure there's no hidden shit lurking underneath."

## Why it matters

- This is the taxonomy behind every individual critique in his chain: the AllocFlow reward/deploy mismatch ([[2026-11-18-quantbeckman-allocflow-reward-deploy-mismatch]]) and the sentiment-paper Sharpe skepticism ([[2026-11-02-quantbeckman-kg-llm-sentiment-sharpe-skepticism]]). His three failure buckets — post-hoc rationalization, data mining, parameter-optimized overfitting — map one-to-one onto the vault's validation cluster (DSR/PBO, walk-forward: [[2026-10-28-margincall4-overfitting-validation-dsr-pbo-walkforward]]).
- The keepable method is his last line, not his ratios: a clean equity curve is stage-one screening, not evidence — the hidden-shit hunt (out-of-sample, frictions, regime splits) is stage two before trusting any shared system. Same bar the group-relative ensemble work is held to ([[2026-11-02-margincall4-bos-intraday-l-s-qqq-variants]]).
- **Skepticism gates:** 973 views / 12 likes is tiny early reach (no bookmark signal); "99%" and "0.01%" are rhetoric, not measurements — no denominator is stated anywhere; the exhibit curve has no axes or stats, so "decent and stable" is unverifiable from the capture; and an unnamed system praised in passing is exactly the kind of claim that dies on contact with its own prescribed second-round test. Watch his feed for the follow-up results rather than treating the curve as the verdict.
